name: congress-trade
description: Congress.Trade app: public STOCK Act disclosures (House, Senate, Executive) served from Coolify Deno-in-Docker at congress.trade.

scripts.deploy: echo 'Production deployment is handled by Coolify on push to main'
scripts.migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: _SENTRY_RELEASE=$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && sentry-cli releases new $_SENTRY_RELEASE --org=simple-with-us --project=congress-trade && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org=simple-with-us --project=congress-trade --release=$_SENTRY_RELEASE --strip-prefix 'dist/..' dist
scripts.postdeploy: if [ -n "$SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN" ]; then npm run sentry:sourcemaps || echo '::warning::sentry sourcemaps upload failed (non-fatal); the Worker deploy already succeeded'; else echo '::warning::SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN not set; skipping sentry sourcemaps upload'; fi
